# Marcellus, vendored

`Marcellus-Regular.ttf` and `OFL.txt` are unmodified from `ofl/marcellus/` of
<https://github.com/google/fonts>, commit `296bb4790d3f9bd95547c733708a3666ed35d844`
(SHA-256 of the font: `1cf0cd10b17d35e852729962cc1ffaffed94514895972458345e2df34abb2f81`).
Licence: SIL Open Font License 1.1, with the Reserved Font Name "Marcellus".

The launcher's serif (titles, menu), embedded in the `oracles` binary at build time
(`launcher/ui/ui_embed.cmake`). Its licence goes with it even embedded:
`OFL.txt` is copied beside the executable as `Marcellus-OFL.txt`. To update:
replace both files and change this file.
